ideas.title: FBI's Refusal to Share Evidence in Alex Pretti Shooting Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the reasons behind the FBI's refusal to share evidence with Minnesota authorities in the Alex Pretti shooting investigation.
ideas.angle: The implications of the FBI's refusal on the case and potential obstruction of justice.
questions: What are the reasons behind the FBI's refusal?
How will this affect the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story is crucial in understanding the dynamics between federal and state agencies in high-profile investigations. It requires a deep dive into the specifics of the case and the potential consequences of the FBI's actions.
